newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower in quiet trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed lower by 0.11 percent on Thursday in quiet trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 548.28 from 548.90 at Wednesday's close.
Volume was 435,126 dinars against 2.52 million dinars.
UBCI bank was down 1.42 dinar to 45.96. Placement de Tunisie fell 1.45 dinar to 14.61. Lease firm Tunisie Leasing slid 0.5 dinar to 30.5.
Real estate firm SIMPAR, listed for the first time, declined 2.78 dinars to 25.22 dinars in a move caused by the removal of subscription rights, the sources said.
Banque du Sud was up 0.98 dinar to 26.1 dinar.
